newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX crude bounces strongly after testing support.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX crude bounces strongly after testing support.

text.p: NYMEX crude futures jumped sharply Thursday aftrenoon, mainly on technical factors.
"Prices bounced off support ($18.96 for front-month May crude) like a trampoline," said one New York trader.
May crude was up 38 cents at $19.65 a barrel at 1440 EDT/1841 GMT, having hit the support-low earlier.

Traders said some market support came from an escalating dispute between Germany, the European Union and Iran after a German court found Iran had ordered the execution of Kurd dissidents in 1992; also, from the temporary closure of the Houston Ship Channel after a barge capsized there.
